text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One of Tracen Academy's teachers was 
getting married, and I attended the 
wedding reception.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Machan, how's the reception desk? The 
guests should be guided to that small room 
over there.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No problem, everything is under control. 
...Even so, you're being even more brisk 
and efficient than usual, Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's our teacher's wedding reception! 
They've taken care of us, so I have to 
repay the favor!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san. Please sign your name 
right here.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet, Scarlet! Can I play the video 
Turbo edited? Can I?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The opening movie? You're supposed to play 
that once the start time arrives.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ehhhh~?! But if we watch it now, 
everyone's gonna get super hyped and go 
waaah!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If you wait, way more people will get to 
see it. Wouldn't you rather have that?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Muuu~~... Fine! Turbo will be patient!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Haaah...! The two of them look just like a 
princess and prince~~...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Um, I understand being captivated by the 
bride and groom, but... quite a few guests 
have empty glasses...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
—My apologies! I shall bring fresh glasses 
at Mach speed~~!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You mean me? Thanks for your concern.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But since I was entrusted with 
coordinating the venue, I'm going to take 
pride in it and see it through perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet puffed out her chest with 
absolute confidence. Her commitment to 
"taking pride in it" was crystal clear 
from how diligently she worked.

text_block_list.name: Host A
text_block_list.text:
The bride will now briefly step away for 
the costume change.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah, I need to go help out. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the wait for the dress change, I 
stepped out to use the restroom. But on my 
way back to the hall...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...No good, it's really not coming out...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san... The truth is, the 
change-of-dress gown...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
A drink splashed onto it and left a stain. 
What should I do...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Well... i-it's not a huge stain, so I'm 
sure nobody will notice!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The lighting in the hall isn't even that 
bright anyway. It'll be totally fine, 
honest!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
............I guess so... It's about time 
we head back inside anyway...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, excuse me...! Is something wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, so that's what happened. Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
In that case, how about we sew some 
flowers from the bouquet over it to hide 
the stain...? I have a sewing kit with me.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Would you... really be able to do that? 
Deep down, I really didn't want to go out 
in front of everyone with a stain on my 
dress.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet-san, could you ask the MC to 
move up the entertainment program? That 
should buy us enough time to sew them on.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, right away!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah... Y-Yes, on it!

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much for waiting, 
everyone. Please give a warm welcome to 
the bride in her lovely new outfit!

text_block_list.name: Woman A
text_block_list.text:
Her outfit change dress is gorgeous~. 
Especially the flowers on it, what a 
wonderful little accent♪
choice_data_list: Looks like we covered it up nicely.
Looks like you guys pulled it off nicely.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. The schedule didn't get delayed 
either, so all's well that ends well... I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Still, Flower's quick thinking really 
saved the day. To think Sensei, who's 
always so bright and easygoing, would be 
that down in the dumps...

text_block_list.name: MC A
text_block_list.text:
And now, the bride has a special message 
for all of our guests.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all so much for gathering here 
today for our sake. And especially to my 
students who helped out. Thanks to every 
one of you—

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Today has become the most radiant, 
brightest day of my entire life. Thank you 
from the bottom of my heart...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—...! ...The most radiant day... of her 
life...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Amidst the ringing applause, Daiwa Scarlet 
wore a solemn expression.
